privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Gujarat Tract Book Store collects, uses, stores, and safeguards your information.
privacy.intro: At Gujarat Tract Book Store, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, submit the Contact form, or choose to send a Product request through WhatsApp.
privacy.agreement: By using our website, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

section1.title: Information We Collect
section1.body: We may collect personal information such as your full name, email address, phone number, and shipping address. Your browser-local Cart stores selected Products, quantities, variants, displayed prices, and Product links. Technical information may include IP address, browser and device type, operating system, pages visited, visit dates and times, and cookies or similar technologies.

section2.title: How We Use Your Information
section2.body: We use information to respond to WhatsApp order requests, provide customer support, answer inquiries, send order and shipping updates, improve our website and services, detect fraud, maintain security, comply with legal obligations, and send promotions or newsletters only when you choose to receive them.

section3.title: Payment Information
section3.body: This website does not collect or process payments. GTBS confirms payment options only after reviewing your WhatsApp request. Never send a UPI PIN, card PIN, password, or banking credential through the website or WhatsApp.

section4.title: Cookies
section4.body: The public storefront does not show a cookie-preference banner or store a consent choice. A signed secure session cookie protects the Admin area after login, while the English or Gujarati preference and public Cart are stored in browser local storage. We do not currently use analytics, advertising, or personalization cookies. Disabling cookies may prevent the Admin login session from working correctly.

section5.title: Information Sharing
section5.body: We do not sell or rent personal information. We share only necessary information with WhatsApp/Meta when you send an order request, Resend when you submit the Contact form, delivery and courier partners, hosting and technology providers, or government authorities when required by law. Partners receive only what they need to perform their services.

section6.title: Data Security
section6.body: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards against unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. No method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely secure.

section7.title: Your Rights
section7.body: You may ask to access, update, or correct your information; request deletion of inquiry information subject to legal duties; withdraw marketing consent; or ask what personal data we hold. Contact us using the details below to exercise these rights.

section8.title: Marketing Communications
section8.body: If you subscribe, we may send new releases, special offers, seasonal promotions, reading recommendations, and event announcements. You can unsubscribe using the link in our emails or by contacting us directly.

section9.title: Third-Party Services
section9.body: Our website may link to or use services such as WhatsApp, Resend, image hosting, shipping providers, and other third parties. We are not responsible for their privacy practices or content. Review their policies before sharing personal information.

section10.title: Children's Privacy
section10.body: Our website is for general audiences. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without parent or guardian consent. Contact us if you believe a child provided personal information so we can act appropriately.

section11.title: Data Retention
section11.body: We keep personal information only as long as needed to complete orders, answer inquiries, comply with legal and tax duties, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Information no longer required is securely deleted or anonymized.

section12.title: Policy Updates
section12.body: We may update this policy when services, legal requirements, or business practices change. Updates appear on this page with a revised effective date. Please review it periodically.

section13.title: Contact Us
section13.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, contact us using the details below.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: The terms governing your use of Gujarat Tract Book Store and purchases requested through WhatsApp.
terms.intro: Welcome to Gujarat Tract Book Store. These Terms & Conditions govern your use of our website and Product requests sent to GTBS through WhatsApp.
terms.agreement: By accessing or using our website, you agree to these terms. If you disagree with any part, please stop using the website.

section1.title: About Gujarat Tract Book Store
section1.body: Gujarat Tract Book Store provides Christian books, Holy Bibles, devotionals, children's books, educational resources, magazines, gifts, and faith-inspired products. We serve readers, families, churches, ministries, and educational institutions with authentic publications and a smooth shopping experience.

section2.title: Acceptance of Terms
section2.body: By visiting the website, adding Products to the browser-local Cart, sending a WhatsApp request, or using our services, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted these Terms & Conditions.

section3.title: Eligibility
section3.body: To request an order through WhatsApp, you must be at least 18 or have parent or legal-guardian permission, provide accurate and complete information, and use the website only for lawful purposes.

section4.title: Products & Availability
section4.body: We aim to keep Product information current, but availability may change without notice. Images are illustrative and may differ slightly. Book editions, covers, or publishers may vary based on availability.

section5.title: Pricing
section5.body: Prices are shown in Indian Rupees and may change without notice because of publisher revisions, promotions, taxes, or market conditions. GTBS confirms the final Product total and delivery charges in WhatsApp before payment.

section6.title: Orders
section6.body: Buy Now and Cart prepare a WhatsApp message for you to review and send. A request becomes an accepted order only after GTBS confirms availability, delivery charges, final total, and payment instructions. We may decline or cancel for pricing errors, stock shortages, suspected fraud, or delivery limits. Refund Policy applies if an accepted paid order is cancelled.

section7.title: Payments
section7.body: The website does not collect or process payment. GTBS provides payment methods and instructions only after confirming the WhatsApp order. Never send a UPI PIN, card PIN, password, or banking credential through the website or WhatsApp.

section8.title: Shipping & Delivery
section8.body: Delivery time varies by location and availability. Delays may arise from courier partners, disasters, government restrictions, holidays, or an incorrect address. Customers must provide accurate shipping information.

section9.title: Returns & Refunds
section9.body: Returns and refunds follow our Return & Refund Policy. Products generally must be unused, in original condition and packaging, and otherwise eligible. Digital or downloadable content and items damaged after delivery may not qualify unless applicable law requires it.

section10.title: Browser-local Cart
section10.body: The website has no customer accounts. Cart data exists only in your current browser. Adding a Product does not reserve stock or lock price. Review names, quantities, variants, and links before sending the WhatsApp message.

section11.title: Intellectual Property
section11.body: Logos, design, graphics, Product descriptions, images, icons, text, and Blog content belong to GTBS or its licensors and are protected by applicable intellectual-property law. Copying, reproduction, distribution, or commercial use requires written permission.

section12.title: Acceptable Use
section12.body: You must not violate laws, attempt unauthorized system access, upload malicious code, scrape content with automated tools, or interfere with website operation. Violations may suspend or terminate access.

section13.title: Third-Party Links
section13.body: External links may be provided for information. GTBS is not responsible for third-party content, privacy practices, services, or products. You access those sites at your discretion.

section14.title: Limitation of Liability
section14.body: To the fullest extent allowed by law, GTBS is not liable for indirect damage, consequential loss, business interruption, data loss, third-party delays, or technical interruptions beyond our control. Total liability will not exceed the value of the customer's order.

section15.title: Privacy
section15.body: Use of this website is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, and protect personal information.

section16.title: Changes to Terms
section16.body: We may update these Terms & Conditions at any time. Updated versions appear here with a revised effective date. Continued use after publication means you accept the updated terms.

section17.title: Governing Law
section17.body: These terms are governed by Indian law. Disputes are subject to the competent courts in the city where Gujarat Tract Book Store operates.

section18.title: Contact Us
section18.body: If you have questions about these Terms & Conditions, contact us using the details below.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shipping.description: How we process, ship, track, and deliver your Gujarat Tract Book Store orders.
shipping.intro: Thank you for shopping with Gujarat Tract Book Store. We are committed to delivering books and faith-inspired products safely and on time. This policy explains how orders are processed, shipped, tracked, and delivered.

section1.title: Order Processing
section1.body: After an order is placed and payment is confirmed, processing usually takes 1–2 business days. Sunday and public-holiday orders start on the next business day. Sales, festivals, or high demand may take longer. We send an email or SMS after processing.

section2.title: Shipping Coverage
section2.body: We deliver across India through reliable courier partners to serviceable addresses. For international shipping, contact customer support before placing an order.

section3.title: Delivery Time
section3.body: Estimated delivery is 1–2 business days for metro cities, 2–3 for other cities, and 3–5 for rural or remote areas. These estimates can change because of courier operations or unforeseen circumstances.

section4.title: Shipping Charges
section4.body: GTBS confirms shipping charges in WhatsApp based on delivery location, order value, package weight, and selected shipping method before you complete the purchase.

section5.title: Free Shipping
section5.body: Free shipping may apply to eligible orders meeting a minimum value. GTBS confirms any offer in WhatsApp before accepting the order.

section6.title: Order Tracking
section6.body: After dispatch, we send a shipping confirmation by email or SMS. Use the supplied tracking information to monitor delivery.

section7.title: Delivery Attempts
section7.body: Courier partners make one or more attempts. Delivery can fail because of an incorrect address, unavailable recipient, or invalid contact details. Returned packages and requested re-delivery may incur additional shipping charges.

section8.title: Packaging
section8.body: Every order is carefully packed to protect books and other products in transit and help them arrive in excellent condition.

section9.title: Damaged or Missing Items
section9.body: For a damaged, incomplete, or incorrect order, contact us within 48 hours, include the order number, and provide clear package and Product photographs when applicable. We will review the request and provide an appropriate resolution.

section10.title: Delivery Delays
section10.body: Delays may occur because of severe weather, disasters, holidays, government restrictions, courier disruption, or unexpected logistics. We appreciate your patience and will provide updates when possible.

section11.title: Incorrect Shipping Information
section11.body: Customers must provide accurate shipping and contact details during WhatsApp confirmation. GTBS is not responsible for delay or failure caused by incomplete information. Contact us immediately after noticing an error; we will try to update it before dispatch.

section12.title: Undeliverable Orders
section12.body: If an order returns because it could not be delivered, we will contact you to arrange re-delivery. Additional shipping charges may apply depending on the reason.

section13.title: Contact Us
section13.body: If you have questions about shipping or delivery, contact us using the details below.

section14.title: Shipping Summary
section14.body: Processing: 1–2 business days. Coverage: across India. Delivery: approximately 2–10 business days depending on location. Tracking is available after dispatch, secure packaging is included, and customer support is available for shipping assistance.

item1.question: How long does shipping take?
item1.answer: Most domestic orders are delivered within 3–7 business days depending on your location. GTBS confirms the available delivery options in WhatsApp before accepting the order.

item2.question: Do you offer international shipping?
item2.answer: Yes, we ship books to selected international destinations. Delivery timeframes and customs duties vary by region.

item3.question: Can I return or exchange a book?
item3.answer: Yes! We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy for unopened and undamaged books in their original condition.

item4.question: Do you offer gift wrapping and personalized notes?
item4.answer: Yes, complimentary gift wrapping and customizable dedication cards are available for selected book orders.

item5.question: How can I track my order?
item5.answer: As soon as your package is dispatched, we send an email with an active tracking link to monitor your delivery progress in real time.

item1.question: What is the mission of GTBS Bookstore?
item1.answer: Our mission is to inspire, educate, and empower readers of all ages with curated Christian literature, Holy Bibles, spiritual devotionals, and transformative faith-based resources.

item2.question: When was the bookstore founded?
item2.answer: We have been faithfully serving literature lovers and faith communities since 2010 with quality books, author events, and educational outreach.

item3.question: Are your books authentic first-party editions?
item3.answer: 100% yes. All our titles are sourced directly from certified global publishers and official distributor houses.

item4.question: Do you host author signings and literary gatherings?
item4.answer: Yes! We host monthly literary events, book launch celebrations, and open reading workshops. Check our Gallery page for past and upcoming events.

item5.question: How do you support youth and school literacy?
item5.answer: We run monthly Children's Story Hours, partner with local libraries, and provide discounted educational book packs to schools and reading clubs.

item1.question: How can I reach customer support?
item1.answer: You can reach our team via email at support@gtbsbooks.com or call us directly at +91 9265429338 or +91 7490028867 during business hours.

item2.question: What are your operating store hours?
item2.answer: Our physical bookstore is open Monday to Saturday from 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM. Our online platform operates 24/7.

item3.question: Where is the flagship bookstore located?
item3.answer: Our store is located at Sahitya Seva Sadan, Shahid Veer Kinariwala Marg, I P Mission Compound, Ellisbridge, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380006.

item4.question: How quickly do you respond to customer inquiries?
item4.answer: We respond to all online inquiries within 24 business hours. For immediate assistance, feel free to contact us via WhatsApp or phone.

item5.question: Can I place bulk or custom institutional orders through contact?
item5.answer: Yes! Use our contact form or email our corporate sales team for special bulk pricing, school libraries, and custom book hampers.

item1.question: Can anyone attend bookstore events and exhibitions?
item1.answer: Yes! Most of our book fairs, storytelling hours, and reading gatherings are free and open to the public. Certain special gala nights may require prior RSVP.

item2.question: How can authors or publishers host a book launch at GTBS?
item2.answer: Authors and publishers can submit an event proposal via our Contact page or email our events committee. We provide venue, audiovisual, and event promotion support.

item3.question: Are photos from past events available for download or media use?
item3.answer: Photos featured in our gallery are available for media coverage and attendees. For high-resolution press packages, please contact our PR team.

item4.question: How frequently are new event photo albums published?
item4.answer: We publish event photo albums within 48 to 72 hours following each major bookstore gathering, author signing, or literary festival.

item5.question: Can I submit photos taken during community events to be featured?
item5.answer: We love sharing community moments! Tag us on social media with #GTBSMoments or send photos to our events email.

item1.question: How often is the GTBS literary journal updated?
item1.answer: We publish fresh reading guides, book reviews, author interviews, and mindfulness tips regularly.

item2.question: Can guest writers and critics submit articles for publication?
item2.answer: Yes! We welcome thought-provoking essays, book critiques, and reading essays from passionate readers and writers. Submit pitches via our contact channel.

item3.question: How are the recommended books chosen in the blog articles?
item3.answer: Our editorial team and literary critics independently review each title based on narrative craft, cultural significance, and reader impact.

item4.question: Can I subscribe to get blog digests directly in my inbox?
item4.answer: Yes! Subscribe to our newsletter at the bottom of any page to receive weekly curated articles and exclusive book promotions.

item1.question: What book formats are available in the shop?
item1.answer: Depending on the title, we offer Hardcover, Paperback, E-Book (EPUB/PDF), and Audiobook editions.

item2.question: How do I know if a book is in stock?
item2.answer: Use Buy Now or send your Cart on WhatsApp. GTBS confirms current availability before accepting the order.

item3.question: Do you offer discounts on bundle purchases?
item3.answer: Yes, we regularly offer seasonal bundle promotions and multi-book discounts across series and genre collections.

item4.question: What payment methods are supported?
item4.answer: Payment options are confirmed by GTBS on WhatsApp after product availability, delivery location, and the final total are verified. The website itself does not collect payment.
